Definition: properly, a speck or point, i.e. (by implication) something; with negative, nothing
BiblicalUsage: The word means anything, and with a negative it means nothing, and it is used where the test is total: Joseph's master kept back nothing from him except his wife, and the dead know not anything. Balaam says he has no power at all to speak beyond God's word, and Israel testifies that Samuel took nothing from any man.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is a measure of a whole life: nothing kept back, nothing taken, nothing spoken beyond God's word — and the man who can say that has kept himself clean.
RelatedPeople: Joseph, Son of Jacob; King Solomon; Balaam; Samuel
